⚠️ Worst Experience with Trinity Air Travel – Highly Unprofessional Service
I had an extremely disappointing experience with Trinity Air Travel due to poor coordination and rude behavior from staff members Shree and Surya.
Here’s what happened:
I inquired about a flight ticket and was provided with a price.
I confirmed the booking and requested bank details for payment.
Despite receiving multiple payment reminders, no bank details were shared, even after repeated follow-ups.
During working hours, the staff claimed they were busy but continued sending reminders without resolving the issue.
Due to this unnecessary delay and lack of coordination, I had to retrieve the bank details from their previous emails myself.
By the time I checked the flight independently, the ticket price had increased, causing me a direct financial loss.
Throughout the process, the staff’s attitude was rude, uncooperative, and highly unprofessional.
This entire experience was a complete waste of time and caused avoidable stress. Such service standards are unacceptable for a professional travel company. I sincerely hope Trinity Air Travel’s management takes this feedback seriously and improves internal coordination and customer handling.
